answer: Creating each new identity costs a fresh bond plus a proof-of-work challenge calibrated so farming identities is far pricier than honest service. An agent must stake collateral locked to a persistent on-chain identity, like a walled garden with a single gate. The ledger then maps reputation across that narrow canyon, letting only verified agents reach the oasis of rewards; duplicate identities gain nothing and forfeit their stake. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
